Read-only FAT12/16 consistency check (entries, chains, cross-links/loops, sizes, lost clusters) gates every delete (boot FULL clean-up and STORAGE_CLEAN). Detects all 9 synthetic corruption classes; real owner FAT = inconsistent (512 erased entries, 717 lost clusters); healthy 8.3 image = consistent. Does not compare FAT1 with FAT2.
A real interrupted ride is kept however short; only demo rides dropped.

Deadlock in summary verification: Cyclift ACKs a queued ride only when it holds that ride's SYNC_RIDE CRC, and asks for summaries with SYNC_REQ after_ride_id = highest board ride id already in its history. The RIDEQ import (and the live mirror of a ride the phone watched) put that id into the history first, so the board never sends the summary -> no RIDEQ_ACK ever: the ride stays 'unsynced' on the board, its samples are never freed, a RAM-only ride's slot is never freed (owner's board: after 4 rides per power cycle the next is lost). Happens whenever the import completes before the 2 s connect-time SYNC (RAM-only/short rides) or Cyclift was connected during the ride.
evidence (firmware @08b639e / iOS @3e548: iOS Link13/RideQueueTransfer.swift:186-195 (ackIfVerified -> requestSummaries); Link13/BoardRideImport.swift:41-43 (boardRideId set); DeviceLink.swift:290-295 (after = highestStoredRideId); Models.swift:1165; RideRecorder.swift:145 (mirror sets boardRideId); firmware app_psvc.c sync (ids > after only)
repro / how verified: code reading of both sides; iOS test RideQueueTransferTests.swift:117-133 feeds the summary by hand, so it does not catch it. Fix: request summaries with after_ride_id = held id - 1 (or a by-id summary request)

summary: COACH_STATE seq: Cyclift's workout_id is stable for the same session (CRC of session + plan) but its seq restarts at 1 after an app relaunch; the board keeps the old seq for that workout and ignores every state until seq passes it (minutes); the board falls back to the stored plan meanwhile. Contract does not say what resets the seq window.

Contract v1.2 still allows a minimal keepalive (fixture vector coach_state_keepalive: id + seq), but the board replaces its whole state with every COACH_STATE (targets blanked). Cyclift sends the full state, so it interoperates today; the contract must say every COACH_STATE is complete (or the board must merge).

The run counters (RTC run_streak and NVS crashrun) survive deep-sleep wakes and are not cleared by stable running, so 4 sporadic crashes days apart (board deep-sleeps between rides) force RECOVERY on the 4th, mid-ride; only RESET/unplug or a software restart clears them.
repro / how verified: boot_probe_rc3 S12: forced RECOVERY at sporadic crash #4 with deep-sleep nights between

summary: rides/synced.txt is matched by ride id only (its CRCs are not compared on load): a ride whose id repeats (residual of QF-24) would be listed as verified and its samples deleted by STORAGE_CLEAN bit1 without its own ACK.

TEST-v0.7.4-rc3 D4 says 'let Cyclift sync TWICE (pull to refresh)': neither the shipped nor the new Cyclift has a pull-to-refresh that requests rides (only storage status); rides sync only at connection. With RC3-01 the expected 'page no longer appears' will usually not happen.

bt_flags (and storage_state/rides_unsynced when 0) are omitted from LIVE when zero; Cyclift never reads bt_flags, and its 'offline rides waiting' falls back to a cached list when LIVE omits tag 14, so it can show a stale non-zero count.
